column1: # expect<TAB>command — `ask` expects a PreToolUse ask decision, `pass` no output
# ha-entities rename asks unless it is a dry run

column2: ha-entities rename light.a light.b --dry-run; ha-entities rename light.a light.b

column1: # ha-integrations delete/disable ask unless it is a dry run; other subcommands pass

column2: ha-integrations delete hue --dry-run && ha-integrations delete hue
ha-integrations list | head; ha-integrations delete hue
for e in sh1 sh2; do ha-integrations delete "$e"; done
ha-integrations list --format json | jq -r '.entries[].entry_id' | xargs -n1 ha-integrations delete
if true; then ha-integrations delete hue; fi
for e in sh1 sh2; do ha-integrations delete "$e" --dry-run; done

column1: # sort -o in a flag cluster, yq -i and uniq's output operand write; comments are not flags
# fd duplications are not commands; &> and >&FILE still name their target
# reads the destructive guard lets through still ask here: sed and cp are not read-only
# ha-secrets: get and add ask in every form, the rest pass; no dry-run exemption

column2: cd /homeassistant && ha-secrets keys; ha-secrets get router_password

column1: # ha-service --unsafe asks in every form; ordinary calls pass
# ha-dashboard delete asks; every other ha-dashboard command passes

column2: ha-dashboard get my-dash > /tmp/my-dash.backup.json && ha-dashboard delete my-dash

column1: # The ha CLI: writes ask in every spelling, position and wrapper

column2: echo core_mosquitto | xargs ha apps restart
for s in a b; do ha apps restart $s; done
ha core info; ha core restart
ha core info && ha apps rebuild x # ha core info

column1: # The ha CLI: reads and routine commands pass
# A verb from stdin or a command substitution still counts

column2: echo core_mosquitto | xargs ha apps logs -n 50

column1: # A #-comment inside $'...' does not hide the rest of the line
# xargs anywhere before ha feeds it words; a text tool after xargs is data

column2: echo restart | timeout 30 xargs ha core
echo restart | sudo -u root xargs ha core

column1: # A flag's value is never the verb or a help flag
# A variable command word could be ha
# ha as an argument to a bundled tool is data
# Quotes and backslashes inside a name bash still runs do not hide it
